shortBio.en: Session guitarist who led the Yardbirds’ late era then founded Led Zeppelin as guitarist-producer.
shortBio.zh: 录音室吉他手：主导 Yardbirds 后期，再以吉他手-制作人身份创立 Led Zeppelin。

whyHub.en: Yardbirds unfinished business → Led Zeppelin production system: personnel bridge into hard-rock’s classic IV.
whyHub.zh: Yardbirds 未竟事务 → Led Zeppelin 制作系统：通向 hard-rock 经典四人的人事桥。

body.en:
Born 1944. Studio years precede Yardbirds (post-Beck); forms Led Zeppelin 1968 with Plant, Jones, Bonham—writes riffs, produces albums, layers guitars.

Hub page for how rock personnel flow: session player → group → new band that redefines arena hard rock. Technique and production credits matter as much as stage myth.
body.zh:
1944 年生。录音室年代早于 Yardbirds（接 Beck 之后）；1968 与 Plant、Jones、Bonham 组建 Led Zeppelin——写 riff、制作专辑、多层吉他。

枢纽页展示摇滚人事如何流动：录音室乐手 → 组合 → 重定义体育场 hard rock 的新乐队。技术与制作 credits 与舞台神话同等重要。

note.zh: Beck 之后的 Yardbirds；Zeppelin 前的实验室。
